condition: dig_threshold_desc:I usually aimed for around the high 30's to low 40's. I felt that below that I would rather spend the time going to a new fresh planet rather than keep going.
planet: surprise_desc:If the number of gems dropped dramatically on the 2nd dig I would move on as I knew it was likely that the 3rd dig would be very low and I would rather go to a new planet with more gems
n_prac_rounds: dynamic_desc:I would stay on planets longer than gave more consistently high gems to try and get the maximum I could while not dwelling on low returning planets
aliens: feedback:Sorry for being late on 1 press! I think I half pressed L and it didn't quite register. Overall I thought the game was a bit tedious but I assume that is part of the experiment design. I hope my participation will be useful to your research
